title: frametrail:attributes of type "urlpreview"
description: Link preview card, or the platform's own embed for posts from Bluesky, X, TikTok, SlideShare, Reddit and Flickr. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "urlpreview". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

originalType.description: The platform the URL belongs to. Set, html is rendered with the platform's embed script.

html.description: Embed HTML from the platform's oEmbed answer.

photoUrl.description: flickr only: URL of the photo.

description.description: Description shown on the card. HTML.

embed.description: Legacy. Written by older versions when the resource was added. Not read.
